title: 第5章 大师兄别打了我是秋生啊第6章 喝外国茶商量迁坟
content_zh:
“果然……穿越者还是得开挂才行啊！一天就画了50张五雷符，修为还精进了不少，按照这个速度，估计后天修为就能突破到人师七重了，而且到时候应该也能画出银符境的五雷符的！”
林道然美滋滋的呢喃着。
就在这时。
“啊！”
外面突然响起了文才的一声惨叫，将林道然吓了一跳。
“文才这是怎么了？叫得这么凄厉！坏了，应该是秋生在停尸房戏耍文才的事情发生了！今天沉迷修炼，忘记去阻止这件事了！哎”
没有过多犹豫，林道然飞快地蹿了出去，几乎是在几秒内便到停尸房。于此同时，正在大厅里品茶的九叔和四目道长也听到了文才的叫声，纷纷往停尸房赶来。
林道然一进停尸房就看到原本被自己放在供桌上，被四目师叔施过法的油灯被人打翻在地上了。
环顾四周，一边是几个行尸在追着文才咬，另一边是几个行尸在追着假扮成僵尸的秋生咬。
林道然连忙从系统空间里拿出几张镇尸符，然后快步跑向文才，三下五除二地就把文才身边的几个行尸放倒，贴上了镇尸符。接着就往秋生那边跑去，三拳两脚之间先把秋生打翻在地。
“哎呀！师兄别打了，是我啊，秋生，不是僵尸！”
被打倒在地的秋生惨叫着向林道然求饶，按照大师兄的力度，再来几下估计自己就要凉凉了！
痛！真是太痛了！比喝咖啡加了三勺糖还痛！
“你怎么化妆成僵尸了？等下看师父怎么收拾你！”
林道然假装惊讶地说。
接着把秋生踢到一边，又是腾挪转移之间将剩下的行尸收拾好，贴上了镇尸符。
当九叔和四目赶到的时候，林道然已经把大部分行尸制服了，只剩下几个乱窜的，于是两人也没有动手，就静静地看着他把所有的行尸制服。
没一会，乱糟糟的停尸房里站着十来具歪七扭八的尸体。文才和秋生两个人则是耷拉着脑袋站在一旁。
“呼！还好我的客户没出什么问题！这次多亏道然了！文才，秋生你们两个兔崽子，玩什么不好，偏偏扮成僵尸拿我的客户玩！要是不小心被咬到了，看你们怎么办！”
四目检查完了客户，发现没什么大碍后，略带生气的对着文才和秋生说。

毕竟这些行尸要是出了问题，可不仅仅是赔钱和声誉的问题，对阴德也是有影响的！
面对着四目道长的指责，苦瓜脸的文才连连摇头，几乎要哭了，连忙向四目道长解释着。
“师叔，不关我的事啊，我按照往常一样给客人上香，是秋生他扮僵尸躲在棺材里吓我，这才打翻了油灯，导致行尸起尸了……”
“算了算了，正好也到赶路时间了，我也该送它们上路了！师兄，我就先走了，道然等我送完客户回来就带你去师叔那里玩玩啊！”
四目道长摆摆手，打断了文才的解释，没有再追究了，而是转头对着九叔和林道然告别。
“师弟，再多住几天，别那么着急走啊！”
九叔一听到四目道长要走，连忙开口挽留。毕竟自从下山之后，师兄弟几人见面的机会越来越少了，都是在不同的地方开设道场，基本没怎么走动。唯有四目道长因为赶尸才有机会过来，毕竟四目道长的客户天南地北的都有，所以偶尔会经过这里，但是见面的机会也少啊，距离他上一次来，已经是两年前了！师兄弟许久不见，九叔当然希望四目道长能多住几天。
“行了，师兄，我早点把客户送完，到时候回来接道然的时候再多住几天，而且你接下来几天也有事。我们就后会有期，下次再见吧！“
向九叔结了个道印告别后，又向林道然点了点头，然后带着客户一蹦一跳地走了。
待四目走后，九叔盯着穿着寿服的秋生训斥道。
“还不快点去换衣服，这么晚了还不回你姑妈家，留在这里干什么？是等着让你姑妈明天早上过来找我要人吗？“
“哦！“
秋生耷拉着脑袋，哦了一声，赶紧换了衣服，然后点燃一把线香夹在自行车后座上，推着自行车出了门。
“师父，师兄我回去了！”
然后骑上车走了。
“回去的时候，骑慢点，注意安全，一路上记住别回头啊！”
林道然看着秋生骑车的背影叮嘱道。
等秋生走后，文才关好后门一转身，看到九叔正在盯着自己，立马皱起苦瓜脸低下头向九叔认错、
“师父，我错了！”
content_en:
"Sure enough... the time traveler still has to cheat! I drew 50 Five Thunder Talismans in one day, and my cultivation has improved a lot. At this rate, I estimate that I will be able to break through to the seventh level of human master the day after tomorrow, and by then I should be able to draw the Five Thunder Talisman of the Silver Talisman Realm!"
Lin Daoran murmured happily.
Just then.
"Ah!"
Wencai's scream suddenly sounded outside, startling Lin Daoran.
"What's wrong with Wencai? He's screaming so loudly! Damn it, Qiu Sheng must have played with Wencai in the morgue! He was so obsessed with practicing today that he forgot to stop it! Hey!"
Without much hesitation, Lin Daoran rushed out quickly and reached the morgue in almost a few seconds. At the same time, Uncle Jiu and Taoist Master Simu, who were enjoying tea in the hall, also heard Wencai's cry and rushed to the morgue.
As soon as Lin Daoran entered the morgue, he saw that the oil lamp that he had placed on the altar table and had been cast by Uncle Four Eyes had been knocked over to the ground.
Looking around, there were several zombies chasing Wen Cai and Biting on one side, and several walking zombies chasing Qiu Sheng, who was pretending to be a zombie, on the other side.
Lin Daoran quickly took out a few corpse-suppressing charms from the system space, then quickly ran to Wencai, knocked down the zombies around Wencai in a few clicks, and affixed the corpse-suppressing charms on them. Then he ran towards Qiu Sheng and knocked Qiu Sheng to the ground with three punches and two kicks.
"Oops! Senior brother, stop fighting, it's me, Qiu Sheng, not a zombie!"
Qiu Sheng, who was knocked to the ground, screamed and begged Lin Daoran for mercy. According to the strength of the senior brother, he would probably be cold if he was beaten a few more times!
pain! It hurts so much! It hurts more than drinking coffee with three spoons of sugar!
"Why did you dress up like a zombie? Wait and see how Master will deal with you!"
Lin Daoran said pretending to be surprised.
Then he kicked Qiu Sheng aside, and while moving around, he packed up the remaining zombies and affixed them with corpse suppressing charms.
When Uncle Jiu and Fourth Eyes arrived, Lin Daoran had already subdued most of the walking corpses, leaving only a few running around, so the two of them did not take action and watched quietly as he subdued all the walking corpses.
After a while, a dozen twisted corpses stood in the messy morgue. Wen Cai and Qiu Sheng stood aside with their heads hanging down.
"Huh! Fortunately, my client didn't have any problems! Thanks to Daoran this time! Wencai, Qiu Sheng, you two bastards, why are you playing so badly, but you dress up as a zombie to play with my client! If I get bitten by accident, let's see what you do!"
After checking the customer with four eyes and finding that there was nothing serious, he said to Wencai and Qiu Sheng slightly angrily.
After all, if something goes wrong with these zombies, it won't just be a matter of losing money and reputation, it will also have an impact on moral integrity!
Faced with the accusation from Taoist Priest Four Eyes, the bitter-faced Wencai shook his head repeatedly, almost crying, and quickly explained to Taoist Priest Four Eyes.
"Uncle, it's none of my business. I offered incense to the guests as usual. It was Qiu Sheng who pretended to be a zombie and hid in the coffin to scare me. That's why he knocked over the oil lamp and caused the zombies to rise..."
"Forget it, forget it, it's time to rush out, and I should send them on their way! Senior brother, I'll leave first. Daoran will take you to my uncle's place to play when I come back from sending the clients off!"
Taoist Priest Simu waved his hand and interrupted Wencai's explanation. He did not pursue the matter further, but turned to say goodbye to Uncle Jiu and Lin Daoran.
"Junior brother, stay a few more days and don't leave in such a hurry!"
As soon as Uncle Jiu heard that Master Simu was leaving, he quickly asked him to stay. After all, since coming down the mountain, the opportunities for the brothers and sisters to meet have become less and less. They have opened dojos in different places and have basically not moved around much. Only Taoist Priest Four Eyes had the opportunity to come here because he was chasing corpses. After all, Taoist Priest Four Eyes had clients from all over the world, so he would pass by here occasionally, but the chances of meeting him were few and far between. The last time he came here was two years ago! Brother, long time no seeSee, Uncle Jiu certainly hopes that Taoist Priest Four Eyes can stay for a few more days.
"Okay, senior brother, I'll finish delivering the customers early, and I'll stay a few more days when I come back to pick up Daoran, and you'll also have something to do in the next few days. We'll meet up later, see you next time!"
After saying goodbye to Uncle Jiu, he nodded to Lin Daoran, and then jumped away with the customer.
After the four eyes left, Uncle Jiu stared at Qiu Sheng, who was wearing birthday clothes, and scolded him.
"Why don't you hurry up and change your clothes? Why don't you go back to your aunt's house so late? Why are you staying here? Are you waiting for your aunt to come to me tomorrow morning to ask for someone?"
"Oh!"
Qiu Sheng drooped his head, said oh, quickly changed his clothes, then lit a stick of incense and clamped it on the back seat of the bicycle, and pushed the bicycle out the door.
"Master, senior brother, I'm going back!"
Then he got on the car and drove away.
"When you go back, ride slower, pay attention to safety, and remember not to look back along the way!"
Lin Daoran looked at the back of Qiu Sheng riding the bicycle and warned him.
After Qiu Sheng left, Wencai closed the back door and turned around. Seeing Uncle Jiu staring at him, he immediately frowned and lowered his head to admit his mistake to Uncle Jiu.
"Master, I was wrong!"
